name: tab_mult
short_desc: Write a program that displays a number's multiplication table.
description:
Write a program that displays a number's multiplication table.

The parameter will always be a strictly positive number that fits in an int,
and said number times 9 will also fit in an int.

If there are no parameters, the program displays \n.

Examples:

$>./tab_mult 9
1 x 9 = 9
2 x 9 = 18
3 x 9 = 27
4 x 9 = 36
5 x 9 = 45
6 x 9 = 54
7 x 9 = 63
8 x 9 = 72
9 x 9 = 81
$>./tab_mult 19
1 x 19 = 19
2 x 19 = 38
3 x 19 = 57
4 x 19 = 76
5 x 19 = 95
6 x 19 = 114
7 x 19 = 133
8 x 19 = 152
9 x 19 = 171
$>
$>./tab_mult | cat -e
$
$>
